case_name: Deoki Panjhiyara vs Shahshi Bhushan Narayan Azad & Anr
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Appellant, wife, filed petition under Section 12 of Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 seeking reliefs including damages and maintenance. Interim maintenance granted by trial court at Rs.2000/- per month.

legal_principles.principle: The legislative intent to include women, living in marriages subsequently found to be illegal or even in relationships resembling a marriage, within the protective umbrella of the DV Act is absolutely clear and must be given its full effect.
legal_principles.held: Learned counsel by referring to the definition of “aggrieved person” and “domestic relationship” as appearing in the DV Act, 2005 has urged that the legislative intent to include women, living in marriages subsequently found to be illegal or even in relationships resembling a marriage, within the protective umbrella of the DV Act is absolutely clear and the same must be given its full effect.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 2

legal_principles.principle: A relationship in the nature of marriage requires proof that parties had lived together in a shared household, and the couple must hold themselves out to society as being akin to spouses, be of legal age to marry, be otherwise qualified to enter into a legal marriage, including being unmarried, and have voluntarily cohabited and held themselves out to the world as being akin to spouses for a significant period of time.
legal_principles.held: They must be of legal age to marry. c) They must be otherwise qualified to enter into a legal marriage, including being unmarried. d) They must have voluntarily cohabited and held themselves out to the world as being akin to spouses for a significant period of time……
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 — Section 2
cited_cases: D. Velusamy vs. D.Patchaimmal, (2012) X SCC Y
keywords: relationship in the nature of marriage
use_in: cases involving relationships resembling a marriage

outcome.final_order: Appellant's application for interim maintenance was affirmed by the learned Sessions Judge.
